text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! With another year
behind
me, I feel like I've peeled off my
old self and
emerged as an even more
disciplined class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of the new and
improved me?
Don't you have a saying
prepared for me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Y-you want one of my sayings?!
Um... let's
see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about this? "Grapes are easier
to peel
once you boil them!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh?! So you're comparing me to a
grape! Looks
like my eye for literary
talent is 20/20! Naturally,
as I don't
need glasses!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Boiling must refer to the hard work I've
put in!
And since grapes grow in
clusters...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then you must be trying to say that if
you put in
the work to peel off your old
self, then your
efforts will surely bear
many fruits!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is a saying that truly fits me like a
glove!
Thank you for the wonderful
present!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(It's more of a cooking tip than a saying,

though...)
